statements.subject: task
statements.description: Task status state shown as TASK_STATE_COMPLETED in response to a structured data exchange request via message:send

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Message object contains a role field (shown as ROLE_USER), a parts array, and a messageId string field

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Part object within a message may include a metadata field containing structured data hints for the desired response format

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Part metadata object contains a mediaType field (e.g., application/json) indicating the desired media type of the structured response

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Part metadata object contains a schema field providing a JSON Schema object describing the desired structure of the response (e.g., array of objects with ticketNumber and description)

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Task response object contains id (string), contextId (string), status (object with state and timestamp), and artifacts (array) fields

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Task status object contains a timestamp field (ISO 8601 datetime string) alongside the state field

statements.subject: artifact
statements.description: Artifact object in the task response contains an artifactId (string) field and a parts array containing Part objects

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Client sends POST /message:send with a message part carrying metadata.mediaType and metadata.schema; server synchronously returns a task in TASK_STATE_COMPLETED state with the structured data payload delivered as text inside an artifact's parts
statements.post_cond: task.state = TASK_STATE_COMPLETED & task.artifacts != null & task.artifacts[0].parts[0].text != null
actions: Client sends POST /message:send with message containing part with metadata.mediaType='application/json' and metadata.schema describing desired structure
Server processes the structured data request
Server returns HTTP 200 with task object whose status.state=TASK_STATE_COMPLETED
Structured data is encoded as JSON text in task.artifacts[0].parts[0].text
